dialogues.en: Taking a pause, I sit up abruptly.
dialogues.text: Taking a pause, I sit up abruptly.

dialogues.en:
I feel the cold air. But it's only slightly chilly, which is
different from the breeze in the dead of winter.
dialogues.text:
I feel the cold air. But it's only slightly chilly, which is
different from the breeze in the dead of winter.

dialogues.en:
"I was supposed to get up when the sun rises high up in the
sky."
dialogues.text:
"I was supposed to get up when the sun rises high up in the
sky."

dialogues.jp: 一息つき、ベッドの上でむくりと起き上がる。
dialogues.en:
I put his arms through my uniform sleeves as I always do,
and leave the room.
dialogues.text:
I put his arms through my uniform sleeves as I always do,
and leave the room.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, niisan."

dialogues.jp:
階段を下りたところで、居間から出てきた音夢
と鉢合わせする。
dialogues.en:
Coming down the stairs, I run into Nemu as she comes out of
the living room.
dialogues.text:
Coming down the stairs, I run into Nemu as she comes out of
the living room.

dialogues.jp: 「おはようさん」
dialogues.en: "Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Good morning."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今から起こしにいこうと思ってたのに、残念」
dialogues.en:
"I was gonna go to your room to wake you up, but... That's
too bad."
dialogues.text:
"I was gonna go to your room to wake you up, but... That's
too bad."

dialogues.jp: 小さく肩をすくめて音夢が笑う。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiles with a slight shrug of her shoulders.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiles with a slight shrug of her shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃ私は先に行きますから。はい、これ。
　朝ご飯にでも食べて」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, I have to go now. Here you are. Eat this for your
breakfast."
dialogues.text:
"Okay, I have to go now. Here you are. Eat this for your
breakfast."

dialogues.jp:
手にしていた――実はずっと気になっていたの
だが――こんにゃくを差し出し、音夢は靴を履
いた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu gives me the yam jelly she'd been holding, which I'd
been wondering about, and she puts her shoes on.
dialogues.text:
Nemu gives me the yam jelly she'd been holding, which I'd
been wondering about, and she puts her shoes on.

dialogues.jp:
袋に入ったこんにゃくを確かめるようにプニプ
ニと揉む。俺にわざわざ手渡すために持ち歩い
てたのか？
dialogues.en:
I squeeze the bag of yam jelly as if to see what it is. Was
she carrying this around to hand it to me?
dialogues.text:
I squeeze the bag of yam jelly as if to see what it is. Was
she carrying this around to hand it to me?

dialogues.jp: あえてその先は考えまい。
dialogues.en: I don't wanna think what lies ahead.
dialogues.text: I don't wanna think what lies ahead.

dialogues.jp: 「もう行くのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you leaving now?"
dialogues.text: "Are you leaving now?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ええ。風紀委員としていろいろと仕事があり
　ますから」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I have many things to do as a disciplinarian."
dialogues.text: "Yes. I have many things to do as a disciplinarian."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「大変だな」
dialogues.en: "That's tough."
dialogues.text: "That's tough."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そう思うなら、余計な仕事を増やさないよう
　にしてくださいね、兄さん」
dialogues.en:
"If you think so, please don't increase the amount of
unnecessary work, niisan."
dialogues.text:
"If you think so, please don't increase the amount of
unnecessary work, niisan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、それは杉並に――」
dialogues.en: "That's because Suginami..."
dialogues.text: "That's because Suginami..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃあ、行ってきます♪」
dialogues.en: "Well, I'm off now."
dialogues.text: "Well, I'm off now."

dialogues.jp: 「とりあえず、飯だな」
dialogues.en: "I guess I should eat breakfast for now."
dialogues.text: "I guess I should eat breakfast for now."

dialogues.jp: 今日は時間があるし、普通に食べるか。
dialogues.en: I can eat normally because I have enough time today.
dialogues.text: I can eat normally because I have enough time today.

dialogues.jp: 「でも、こいつはどうすっかな……」
dialogues.en: "Now what should I do with this......?"
dialogues.text: "Now what should I do with this......?"

dialogues.jp:
手のなかにあるこんにゃくをモミモミしつつ、
台所へと向かった。
dialogues.en:
I head for the kitchen, squeezing the bag of yam jelly in my
hand.
dialogues.text:
I head for the kitchen, squeezing the bag of yam jelly in my
hand.

dialogues.jp: 「行ってきます……」
dialogues.en: "I'm leaving now......"
dialogues.text: "I'm leaving now......"

dialogues.jp:
誰もいない家に向かってなんとなく呟くと、玄
関の鍵を閉め、ポケットにしまいこむ。
dialogues.en:
Muttering to the empty house, I lock up the house and put
the key in my pocket.
dialogues.text:
Muttering to the empty house, I lock up the house and put
the key in my pocket.

dialogues.jp:
見上げれば、｛まぶ／眩｝しいばかりの青空が広がってい
た。
dialogues.en: Looking up, I saw a beautiful sky spreading out.
dialogues.text: Looking up, I saw a beautiful sky spreading out.

dialogues.jp:
他の学生の流れにのりながら、学園に続く一本
道をゆっくりと進む。授業のあるときに比べる
と、学生の数が格段に少ない。
dialogues.en:
Keeping up with the stream of other students, I slowly walk
down the path to school. Compared with a regular school day,
the number of students is very low.
dialogues.text:
Keeping up with the stream of other students, I slowly walk
down the path to school. Compared with a regular school day,
the number of students is very low.

dialogues.jp:
後ろからかけられた声に振り返ると、ことりが
爽やかな笑みを浮かべて駆け寄ってくる。
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.jp:
……そうだと言いきれない自分が情けない。こ
ういう時は、話を変えるに限る。
dialogues.en:
Like a car parked on the road, Mako is standing at the
entrance of the path that leads to the school.
dialogues.text:
Like a car parked on the road, Mako is standing at the
entrance of the path that leads to the school.

dialogues.jp: 「ことりは卒パの準備か？」
dialogues.en: "What are you doing here?"
dialogues.text: "What are you doing here?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「ええ。友達と一緒に楽曲の演奏をするんです。
　良かったら聴きにきてくださいね」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
ことりの歌声を知っている者としては、期待し
ないわけにはいかない。
dialogues.en:
With a relieved look on her face as if a person she was
waiting for has shown up, she walks close to me.
dialogues.text:
With a relieved look on her face as if a person she was
waiting for has shown up, she walks close to me.

dialogues.jp:
俺は期待の度合いを表すべく、オーバーに頷い
て見せた。
dialogues.en: "?-Uh, were you waiting for me?"
dialogues.text: "?-Uh, were you waiting for me?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃ私、友達を待たせちゃってるんで先
　に行きますね。バイバイ♪」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
パタパタと駆けていくことりの背中をひらひら
と手を振りながら見送る。
dialogues.en: Why is that......?
dialogues.text: Why is that......?

dialogues.jp: と、前方に向けた視界に、見知った姿が映る。
dialogues.en: "Did you receive a letter again?"
dialogues.text: "Did you receive a letter again?"

dialogues.jp: 「おやっ？」
dialogues.en: This must be quite a devoted girl.
dialogues.text: This must be quite a devoted girl.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "No, that's not right. I was just waiting for you, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "No, that's not right. I was just waiting for you, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
待ち人が来たかのようにホッとした表情を見せ、
俺のそばによってくる。
dialogues.en: "Me?"
dialogues.text: "Me?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そうだけど」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I was gonna go to the music room with you."
dialogues.text: "Yes. I was gonna go to the music room with you."

dialogues.jp: なんでまた……。
「もしかして、また手紙が届いたのか？」
dialogues.en: What brought that on?
dialogues.text: What brought that on?

dialogues.jp: なかなか熱烈な｛こ／娘｝じゃないか。
dialogues.en: "What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What happened?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「違う、そうじゃないってば。ただ朝倉を待っ
　てただけ」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing special. I just felt like walking to school with
you. And that way we can look like we have just started
dating."
dialogues.text:
"Nothing special. I just felt like walking to school with
you. And that way we can look like we have just started
dating."

dialogues.jp: なんか妙に、ニコニコしてるな。
dialogues.en:
"If that's the case, that's fine... But if you wanted to do
that, we could have arranged to meet here, right?"
dialogues.text:
"If that's the case, that's fine... But if you wanted to do
that, we could have arranged to meet here, right?"

dialogues.jp: 眞子はめったにないほど上機嫌だった。
dialogues.en: Instead of waiting for me in this kind of place.
dialogues.text: Instead of waiting for me in this kind of place.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「な、何よ？」
dialogues.en: "It's OK."
dialogues.text: "It's OK."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「何かいいことあったのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Even if we arranged something, can you really come on
time?"
dialogues.text:
"Even if we arranged something, can you really come on
time?"

dialogues.jp: 眞子がぎょっとして、自分の顔に手を当てる。

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ど……どうだっていいでしょ」
dialogues.en: "See?"
dialogues.text: "See?"

dialogues.jp:
恋人同士という単語に、眞子が顔を真っ赤にし
て反応する。
dialogues.en:
Well, in a good way I can say that I'm the type who does
things at my own pace.
dialogues.text:
Well, in a good way I can say that I'm the type who does
things at my own pace.

dialogues.jp: 言って、上目遣いに眞子が微笑む。
dialogues.en: I never describe myself badly.
dialogues.text: I never describe myself badly.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「いいの、これで」
dialogues.en: "Come on, let's go."
dialogues.text: "Come on, let's go."

dialogues.jp: まあ、俺はよく言えばマイペースだからな。
dialogues.en:
Tagging along with Mako, who's somehow in a good mood, I
walk under the cherry blossom in full bloom as usual.
dialogues.text:
Tagging along with Mako, who's somehow in a good mood, I
walk under the cherry blossom in full bloom as usual.

dialogues.jp: ◆一緒に音楽室へ◆
学校に向かうと、校門の所に眞子がいた。
どうやら俺のことを待っていてくれたらしい。

昨日の夢のせいなのか、上機嫌な眞子に、何故
か俺の頬も緩むのだった。
